hooks.command: { input=$(cat); f=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // empty'); sid=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.session_id // "unknown"'); case "$f" in ""|*memory.md) ;; "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) touch "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/.memory_pending_$sid" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
hooks.statusMessage: Noting that a file changed (memory.md journal)

hooks.command: { input=$(cat); sid=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.session_id // "unknown"'); flag="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/.memory_pending_$sid"; mem="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/memory.md"; find "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude" -maxdepth 1 -name '.memory_pending*' -mmin +2880 -delete; if [ -f "$flag" ] && [ "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false')" != "true" ]; then if [ "$mem" -nt "$flag" ]; then rm -f "$flag"; else rm -f "$flag"; jq -n '{decision: "block", reason: "You edited files this session but have not yet logged them in memory.md at the repository root. Before finishing: append a new entry to memory.md (create the file if it is missing, never delete earlier entries). The entry must start with a ## heading containing the current date and a short title, then explain WHAT changed, WHICH files (paths), and WHY - written for a student who is new to programming: define every technical term in plain language the first time it appears. Then stop."}'; fi; fi; } 2>/dev/null
hooks.statusMessage: Checking whether memory.md needs a journal entry
